import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate the CSV
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
totals = df.groupby('region', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum().sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
bars = ax.barh(totals['region'], totals['revenue'], color='#4C78A8')
ax.invert_yaxis()  # Display largest at top
ax.set_xlim(0, totals['revenue'].max() * 1.18)
ax.set_xlabel('Total revenue')
ax.set_title('Total Revenue by Region')
ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f'{v:,.0f}' for v in totals['revenue']], padding=4)
ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.25)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
